title: Running Parcel Totals
description:
For each position in weights, return the sum of all weights from the start through that position, in the original order.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [2,3,-1]
Output: [2,5,4]

Constraints:
- 0 <= weights.length <= 100
- Each weight is an integer from -100 to 100

title: Earliest Lonely Letter
description:
Return the index of the first character that occurs exactly once in text. Indices start at zero. Return -1 if every character repeats or text is empty.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: "swiss"
Output: 1

Constraints:
- 0 <= text.length <= 100
- text contains only lowercase English letters

title: Sorted Shelf Union
description:
Combine two nondecreasing integer arrays. Return each distinct value once, in increasing order.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,2,2], [2,3]
Output: [1,2,3]

Constraints:
- 0 <= each array length <= 60
- Values are integers from -100 to 100
- Both input arrays are sorted in nondecreasing order

title: Round Bracket Audit
description:
Return true if each opening parenthesis has a later matching closing parenthesis and no closing parenthesis appears before its match. The empty string is valid.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: "(()())"
Output: true

Constraints:
- 0 <= text.length <= 100
- Characters are only ( and )

title: Shelf Insertion Index
description:
Return the smallest index whose value is at least target in a sorted array. If no such value exists, return the array length.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,3,3,7], 3
Output: 1

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 100
- Values and target are integers from -100 to 100
- values is sorted in nondecreasing order

title: Best Single Resale
description:
Buy once and sell on a later day, or make no trade. Return the largest possible profit. Each array entry is the price on that day.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [7,1,5,3,6,4]
Output: 5

Constraints:
- 0 <= prices.length <= 100
- Each price is an integer from 0 to 1000

title: Zeroes to the Tail
description:
Return an array with all nonzero values in their original order followed by all zeroes. Preserve the length and do not sort the nonzero values.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [0,3,0,-2,4]
Output: [3,-2,4,0,0]

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 100
- Each value is an integer from -100 to 100

title: Longest Equal Streak
description:
Return the length of the longest contiguous run of equal values. Return zero for an empty array.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [2,2,1,1,1,3]
Output: 3

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 100
- Each value is an integer from -100 to 100

title: Matching Pair Count
description:
Count index pairs (i, j) with i < j and values[i] equal to values[j]. Different index pairs count separately.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,2,1,1]
Output: 3

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 100
- Each value is an integer from -100 to 100

title: Shared Starting Text
description:
Return the longest string that is a prefix of every word. Return an empty string when words is empty or there is no common prefix.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: ["flower","flow","flight"]
Output: "fl"

Constraints:
- 0 <= words.length <= 30
- Each word has 0 to 60 lowercase English letters

title: Distinct Window Length
description:
Return the maximum length of a contiguous substring with no repeated character. Return zero for empty text.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: "abcabcbb"
Output: 3

Constraints:
- 0 <= text.length <= 100
- text contains lowercase English letters

title: Target Segment Count
description:
Count nonempty contiguous subarrays whose sum equals target. Subarrays with different start or end positions count separately.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,1,1], 2
Output: 2

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 100
- Values and target are integers from -100 to 100

title: Next Warmer Wait
description:
For each day return how many days must pass until a strictly higher temperature occurs. Return zero for that day if none follows.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [73,74,75,71,69,72,76,73]
Output: [1,1,4,2,1,1,0,0]

Constraints:
- 0 <= temperatures.length <= 100
- Temperatures are integers from -50 to 100

title: Merged Booking Spans
description:
Each closed interval is [start, end]. Merge intervals that overlap or share an endpoint. Return the merged intervals sorted by start, with no overlaps.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[10,12]]
Output: [[1,6],[8,12]]

Constraints:
- 0 <= intervals.length <= 50
- Integer endpoints satisfy -50 <= start <= end <= 50

title: Fewest Coin Pieces
description:
Return the fewest coins needed to sum to amount when each denomination can be used unlimited times. Return -1 if impossible. Amount zero needs zero coins.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,2,5], 11
Output: 3

Constraints:
- 1 <= coins.length <= 8; denominations are distinct positive integers at most 20
- 0 <= amount <= 80

title: Strict Ascent Length
description:
Return the longest length of a strictly increasing subsequence. You may skip elements but cannot reorder them. Equal values cannot extend the subsequence.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [10,9,2,5,3,7,101,18]
Output: 4

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 100
- Each value is an integer from -100 to 200

title: Island Cluster Count
description:
Count groups of cells containing 1 connected horizontally or vertically. Diagonal contact does not connect groups. Cells containing 0 are water.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [[1,1,0],[0,1,0],[1,0,1]]
Output: 3

Constraints:
- grid is [] or a rectangular array with 1 to 8 rows and 1 to 8 columns
- Every cell is 0 or 1

title: Exact Subset Count
description:
Count subsets of indices whose selected values sum to target. Each index may be selected at most once. Equal values at different indices remain different choices. Count the empty subset when target is zero.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,2,3], 3
Output: 2

Constraints:
- 0 <= values.length <= 16
- Each value is an integer from 0 to 20
- 0 <= target <= 100

title: Shortest Unweighted Route
description:
Return the fewest edges on a route from start to end in an undirected graph, or -1 if unreachable. Vertices are numbered 0 through n-1. A route from a vertex to itself has length zero.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: 5, [[0,1],[1,2],[0,3],[3,4],[4,2]], 0, 2
Output: 2

Constraints:
- 1 <= n <= 20
- edges contains distinct pairs of different valid vertices
- start and end are valid vertices

title: Histogram Banner Area
description:
Adjacent bars each have width one. Return the largest area of a rectangle contained under the histogram. A rectangle may span consecutive bars only.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [2,1,5,6,2,3]
Output: 10

Constraints:
- 0 <= heights.length <= 100
- Each height is an integer from 0 to 100

title: Window Peak Sequence
description:
Slide a window of width elements from left to right by one position at a time. Return the maximum in each window in that order.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [1,3,-1,-3,5,3,6,7], 3
Output: [3,3,5,5,6,7]

Constraints:
- 1 <= values.length <= 100
- 1 <= width <= values.length
- Each value is an integer from -100 to 100

title: Rain Between Pillars
description:
Unit-width pillars stand side by side on level ground. Return the total number of unit squares of water that remain between them after rain; water beyond either end drains away.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: [0,1,0,2,1,0,1,3,2,1,2,1]
Output: 6

Constraints:
- 0 <= heights.length <= 100
- Each height is an integer from 0 to 100

title: Cheapest Stick Cuts
description:
Cut a stick at every listed position. A cut costs the length of the current piece being cut. Choose the order to minimize total cost and return that cost. Positions are measured from the original left end.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: 7, [1,3,4,5]
Output: 16

Constraints:
- 1 <= length <= 100
- cuts contains 0 to 8 distinct integer positions strictly between 0 and length
- cuts may be unsorted

title: Queens Placement Count
description:
Place size queens on a size by size chessboard so no two share a row, column, or diagonal. Return the number of distinct placements. Rotations and reflections count separately when their occupied squares differ.

The function must RETURN the result, not print it.

Example:
Input: 4
Output: 2

Constraints:
- 1 <= size <= 8
